description: The photo markers an exported image draws (docs/SPEC.md FR-4.10), grouped and sized as on screen (photoClusters, photoMarkerSize). Points ({ id, x, y }) are in route order, in screen pixels from the frame's top-left; loneId keeps a marker of its own; activeId's marker is larger and drawn last. A marker whose circle lies wholly outside the width × height frame is left out. Expected: { ids, x, y, diameter, active, small }, positions and diameter multiplied by scale (output pixels per screen pixel).

cases.name: none below the zoom tracks start at
overlapping photos are one group at the first
zoomed out the markers are small and group closer
the active photo is larger and drawn last
small and active is full size
the lone photo stays out of every group
a circle partly in the frame is kept; one wholly outside is left out, its group with it
